release.name: Thanks for Nothing v0.11.0
release.body:
Thanks for Nothing v0.11.0 publishes the manuscript and reproducible research code as one public root snapshot. The combined manuscript/code archive is https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23402517.

Snapshot: https://github.com/docxology/thanks_for_nothing/tree/ce00ab04a6d3e41c2374903728d76893331655bb

Original paper and figures: CC BY 4.0. Original code: MIT. Third-party rights remain separate. Original unlicensed notebooks and raw scholarly downloads are excluded; local acquisition is documented in docs/external-inputs.md.

The attached manifest records every payload size and SHA256. Synthetic results concern finite models and software, not established human gratitude, clinical benefit or contemplative realization.

record.title: Thanks for Nothing: Gratitude, Model Revisability, and the Practice of Realizing Emptiness
record.description:
Gratitude can concern a benefit received, a harm that did not occur, or the conditions that make one's own assumptions examinable. We develop the proposal that appreciating these conditions can orient practice toward realizing emptiness: examining how distinctions arise, relinquishing their assumed intrinsic necessity, and retaining their conditional usefulness. The argument distinguishes an observed absence, a missing observation, counterfactual valuation and non-reification, and places their differences in dialogue with explicitly situated philosophical and scriptural sources. We reconstruct Fisher, Sandved Smith and Hohwy's gratitude and gaze notebooks, then separate faithful reconstruction from corrected experiments and new mechanisms. GNN-declared paired recall experiments use 5120 independent agent-world units, matched environmental exposure and replay dose, normalized likelihoods, and independent predictive assessment. Pinned Realizing Emptiness interfaces supply structural admission and finite mathematical comparators. An enacted inquiry model separates appreciation, costly activity, access to alternatives and evidence-responsive retention or revision; explicit learning-to-gaze and joint scene/encoding experiments examine transfer and identifiability. Exact count enumeration, mathematical nulls, paired controls and joint bootstrap inference make the resulting software claims independently checkable.

Selective positive recall reduces the declared optimism summary, while its predictive consequences depend on the world mixture and the specified transfer bridge. Counterfactual absence valuation preserves inference by construction. Accessible inquiry can revise a contradicted restriction and retain a useful one; activity without access instead incurs costs while preserving rigid forecasts. Exact analysis exposes rare adverse selections absent from seeded realizations. The original gaze code reproduces the pre-intervention occupancy but contains no implemented after intervention. Our active-scene extension finds a context-dependent access advantage without an additional inquiry-specific predictive advantage. Joint scene/encoding inquiry distinguishes learning an encoding from combining it with scene evidence: observationally equivalent labels remain unidentifiable, and excluded hypotheses cannot be recovered. Known-answer fixtures also retain skew-related undercoverage and unavailable rare-event estimates rather than treating replication size as a remedy for every inferential failure. The contribution is a reproducible account of enabling operations and their limits, together with a falsifiable human research program that separates inquiry value from patience, anticipated good news and instrumental information demand. Synthetic model results establish neither human gratitude nor contemplative realization or clinical benefit. Code, declared models and reproducibility materials are available at github.com/docxology/thanks_for_nothing.

release.name: Black Line 0.5.0
release.body:
# Release packet — Black Line 0.5.0 (2026-10-21)

Implements the 2026-10-20 review at `a40aa78`, received 2026-10-21.
Recorded email-body SHA-256:
`f7e3c65efbe43f8cc7943bbdebd285f697edafabf2f18a234d7ad635e324922a`.
All dispositions below ship in the release commit containing this packet.

## Downstream compatibility

**Exported enum member names and the ten-field `line.report-envelope/1.0`
shape are unchanged.** `canonical_assessment/1.0` bytes/report digests remain
unchanged, bound to a fixture executed at `a40aa78`. `registry_version` now
comes from evaluation time; old manually constructed results have an unknown
version and strict export rejects them.

New runtime assessment fields are `evaluator_version`, `evidence_declared`,
and `intake_codes`. The separate `black_line.evaluation-record/1.0` retains
them; the old canonical format does not. No sibling repository was edited.

## Contract decisions

- Preserve `refresh_horizon` as observation expiry, including non-applicable
  and shadowed occurrences, because existing valid-input tests establish that
  broader behavior. Add `effective_refresh_queue` for applicable, unshadowed
  expiry predictions with structured exclusions and exact surface transitions.
  A surface change need not change the overall status.
- Preserve strict evaluator staleness (`age > window`). In this minor release,
  `days_until_stale` counts through the first stale day. `last_fresh_on`,
  `stale_on`, and `days_until_last_fresh_day` expose the boundary and retain
  the old arithmetic under its accurate name.

## Review dispositions

| Item | Disposition and acceptance evidence |
| --- | --- |
| 1 (P1) | Done: shared `intake.py`; normalized matching, raw diagnostic labels, occurrence indexes, malformed omissions, configuration parity and None policy. `test_review_refresh.py`. |
| 2 (P1) | Adapted by the explicit two-view decision above. Applicable practice filtering, undated/newer shadowing and exact evaluator-derived boundary transitions; excluded observations remain available. `test_review_refresh.py`. |
| 4 (P1) | Done: immutable replay schema retains supported original declarations, normalized intake, pinned date/window/version, complete ordered registry and digest, result/surfaces/context, subject/references and non-claims. Loader verifies registry content; exact replay requires the recorded package. Arbitrary objects are rejected under the documented safe JSON intake. Round trips, input/configuration/version/output mutations and old-schema fixture: `test_review_archive.py`, `test_archive_integrity.py`. |
| 5 (P1) | Done: narrow report correspondence plus separate structured contract validation and replay-context correspondence. All ten fields have mutation/type cases; string/bytes refs fail, iterable collections work, incomplete old results fail strict export. `test_review_archive.py`, `test_archive_integrity.py`. |
| 3 (P2) | Done: explicit last-fresh/first-stale dates and deliberate minor-version day-count change. Zero window, boundary, already stale, year rollover and leap day are tested; recipes, figure captions and derived ledger agree. `test_review_refresh.py`. |
| 6 (P2) | Done: shared shape defects reject unnormalized tags/requirements and duplicate requirements before scoring, with codes and readable notes; shipped policy remains separate from valid custom shape. `test_review_coherence.py`. |
| 7 (P2) | Done: malformed fields, non-records and combinations return named failures, retaining seven identities and blocked reasons. Existing real/planted controls remain. `test_review_coherence.py`, `test_invariants.py`. |
| 8 (P2) | Done: export attempt-wide context and `project_finding`; reconstruct status/reasons without consulting expected findings, including empty versus irrelevant evidence. Replay and formalism retain the distinction. `test_review_coherence.py`, `test_witness_surfaces.py`. |
| 9 (P2) | Done: matching method digests required for family attribution; unresolved/missing/old-empty provenance is UNKNOWN. Mixed methods partition by digest while overall counts remain. Same-ID/different-kind, missing-ID, mixed and empty cases: `test_review_coherence.py`. |
| Documentation | Done: historical core/current family; actual dev dependency group; complete omission categories. README, recipes, formalism, claim boundaries, standalone and agent guidance synchronized. |
| Cosmetic coverage-only arc | Declined as explicitly instructed by the review; no coverage-only override added. |

## Execution evidence

Final regression modules against an isolated `a40aa78` export: **60 failed,
11 passed**, including failures for every numbered finding. The earlier
52-failure run preceded stronger omission-reason assertions. Per-patch red
runs are retained as well. Baseline suite: **353 passed, 4 failed, 98.35%**
branch coverage; version drift, unlisted already-published DOIs and format
drift were repaired. Zenodo's public API confirmed the previously committed
newer DOI strings; no DOI was reserved or minted.

Release tree: **463 passed, 98.17% branch coverage**, unchanged 90% floor,
no skips. Registry: **11 practices**, digest
`a02bff47a767b545bdeca7677bd1a2e1b24f1147d0847ec361fa9ee8b9ea1846`.
Figure contract: **15 figures + cover**. Lint, format and compilation pass.
This repository declares no static type-checker command.

```bash
uv sync --locked
uv run python scripts/build_figures.py
uv run pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=90 --cov-report=term-missing
uv run ruff check src tests scripts
uv run ruff format --check src tests scripts
uv run python scripts/check_registry.py
uv run python scripts/check_figures.py
uv run python scripts/gen_formalism_ledger.py
uv run python -m compileall -q src tests scripts
uv build --out-dir output/dist
```

Wheel/sdist build; an isolated installed wheel outside the checkout completes
a serialize/load/replay round trip. Environment and base interpreter resolve
on GitVault. Generated artifacts are ignored and are not claimed to ship in Git.

## Publication boundary

Engine: isolated detached worktree of `docxology/template` origin/main
`4670c48cc490636455f2eac09ba4396baed9ffd7`; the in-use checkout was untouched.
PDF/HTML/EPUB render. Inspected cover, method and changed expiry prose/figure;
HTML has 16 loaded images, no broken images or desktop horizontal overflow.
The PDF remains untagged, as previously documented.

The engine's broad public-exemplar audit rejected standalone packaging
(template overlays/backlog/tracked-output requirements). This is a recorded
contract conflict, not a green result: Black Line declares its own package,
layout and ignored output. No template overlays, waivers, lowered thresholds
or engine patches were added. The independent audit must assess this boundary.
The declared render/validation commands and publication metadata checks remain
the applicable release surface.

The initial Python 3.12 Stage 04 attempt hung in Git-ignore subprocess I/O;
it was terminated with diagnostics retained. Python 3.14 resolved the stall;
an archive-only attempt then failed `STAGE_SOURCE_MISSING` because provenance
needs indexed stage sources. A new independent bare repository and detached
worktree at the same pinned commit resolved that prerequisite without writing
inside the in-use engine checkout. The documented invocation now uses a managed
`projects/working/black_line` leaf and a real Git engine checkout.

Both declared stages pass on the final rendered manuscript:

```bash
uv run python scripts/pipeline/stage_03_render.py --project working/black_line
uv run python scripts/pipeline/stage_04_validate.py --project working/black_line
```

Stage 04 binds 58 source, 10 configuration and 54 output files. All content,
format, registry, evidence, design-overlay, artifact-manifest and provenance
checks pass. The 43-page PDF has no undefined references; five small overfull
table boxes remain in the pre-existing incremental-declaration table, within
the page at visual inspection. All 33 generated figure artifacts are
byte-identical across consecutive builds. Visual inspection is sampled, not
an all-page accessibility or layout certification.

The broader exemplar audit remains a recorded failure. Stage 04's diagnostic
layer also lists numeric-evidence warnings (including the derived caption's
`18`) and source image-path notes despite its passing evidence/Markdown gates.
The numbers are derived and bound by package tests; rendered images were
inspected separately. These diagnostic limits are not claimed as resolved.

## Release artifacts (SHA-256)

| Asset | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `black_line-0.5.0.pdf` | `41c21bb1c6e8e31076e22e2c3758509dc7047b0e1529463b19ee64b742273c4d` |
| `black_line-0.5.0.epub` | `988deb3d762a70139e94dd8eb373f5336ba12c29bcdc7d6790f7f4279cacc546` |
| `black_line-0.5.0-web.zip` | `b13beea59f674f2c2dbba7ad990f0d04ccb2c8f1956cee7f4430d6367c88ad7e` |
| `black_line-0.5.0-py3-none-any.whl` | `e1791142d00d00d738bc96024285553e85cc370dd6ae8c602ae542936b4ba058` |
| `black_line-0.5.0.tar.gz` | `0a98b689e6c273face28a837e64447581e60ea87e2c9e2f9742f8e811e99c198` |

The web ZIP retains `output/web` and `output/figures` together so relative
image and stylesheet references remain usable after extraction.

## DOI and release follow-up

Declarations agree at 0.5.0. Retained DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22833503` identifies
archived 0.4.1, not a new 0.5.0 deposit. Daniel must reserve the new DOI,
update verified metadata, re-render, upload and publish in that order.
The old DOI is retained only in historical references and an `isNewVersionOf`
relation; current citation identifiers and the current cover omit it.

## Independent audit repairs

The first independent read-only audit required three P2 repairs. Five new
regression cases failed before the fixes: exact nested projection booleans
(`0`/`1`), two calendar-range overflows, and old-DOI/current-edition assignment.
The fixes validate exact boolean/null context and compare canonical replay
identity, explain unrepresentable expiry with a structured omission while
preserving evaluator window policy, and retain the last verified DOI only as
historical metadata. `test_release_audit.py` binds these repairs.

The second independent read-only round **APPROVED source implementation and
compatibility**, with no remaining concrete P1/P2 findings. It ran 105 focused
regressions plus 257 additional tests, 500 canonical comparisons against the
pinned base, 500 serialize/load/replay cases, and 1,296 inventory/boundary cases.
It verified enum, registry, canonical-result and envelope compatibility. That
approval did not certify pending release receipts; the full-suite, rendered
provenance and artifact checks reported here are the producer's own runs.

GitHub hooks returned `[]` during preparation and will be rechecked before a
Release object is created. Use annotated `v0.5.0`; push main/tag only through
the vault lease and verify both against origin. No cross-line compensation,
scientific claim, citation, authority or permission was introduced.

record.title: Personal Red Lines for Development
record.description:
A versioned, evidence-gated personal security boundary and explicit No document for dual-use development work. It requires a complete, reviewable action intake before returning compliance, distinguishes outside-scope work from compliance, and records uncertainty as a blocking result rather than a permission. It is a personal auditability aid, not enforcement, legal compliance, semantic safety classification, or external certification.

Subtitle: An Evidence-Gated Personal Security Boundary and Explicit No Document for Dual-Use Development

Code is MIT licensed; prose and figures are CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE in the repository.

record.title: White Line: A Typed Ledger for the Edge of the Claim
record.description:
A typed ledger for absence: epistemic gaps, ethical restraint, and contemplative negative space. It records what is missing, withheld, or unresolved under a total caution order, decays stale namings past their review horizons, and refuses to infer why anything is absent. Withholding is recorded as a boundary, never mined as missing evidence.

Subtitle: Keeping missing evidence, ethical boundaries, and open questions from becoming unsupported claims

# Release packet — Golden Line 0.5.0 (2026-10-21)

Repository: <https://github.com/docxology/golden_line>. Intended annotated tag:
`v0.5.0`. Implementation commit: `bea6fc169e08df0338e2a027b5f7ef323746e978`.
The tag resolves the final release commit; the attached evidence manifest records
that exact revision without a self-referential checksum in this file.

## Review disposition and commits

All G1–G11 implementation changes are in `bea6fc1`; `2d5b1ba` resolves the
independent audit findings and corrects the external engine invocation. The
release commit adds the final evidence packet.
The full acceptance mapping and reasons are in
[the disposition](../reviews/2026-10-20.md).

| Item | Disposition | Commit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| G3 | Done: validated immutable registry boundary, structured errors, explicit custom identity | `bea6fc1` |
| G7 | Adapted: finite passive token domain, explicit date/integer boundaries; outer iterator failures excluded | `bea6fc1`, `2d5b1ba` |
| G8 | Done: finite reference sequences with order/duplicates retained, contents unverified | `bea6fc1` |
| G1 | Done: strict instrument validator separate from narrow present correspondence | `bea6fc1`, `2d5b1ba` |
| G2 | Adapted: existing native bytes/digests retained; versioned sidecar and order-aware typed decoder | `bea6fc1` |
| G6 | Done: rejected contradictions retained separately, first-wins unchanged | `bea6fc1` |
| G4 | Done: SVG/source raster replay, checksums, converter provenance | `bea6fc1` |
| G5 | Done: malformed shape, exact mapping/cardinality, paths/encoding/inventory checks | `bea6fc1` |
| G10 | Done: standalone CI and exact-revision command/output manifest; mutation-sensitive failure control | `bea6fc1`, `2d5b1ba` |
| G9 | Adapted: optional provenance/conflict side records, reviewed design, synthetic tension examples | `bea6fc1` |
| G11 | Done: founding history/current family distinction, scope examples/guard, schema-valid citation metadata | `bea6fc1`, `2d5b1ba` |

No item was silently dropped. No scientific or empirical claim was added.
Registry vocabulary and the four statuses remain unchanged. Historical release
notes, registry revision and transport schemas retain their distinct versions;
0.5.0 is greater than every preceding package version, including 0.4.1.

## Local gates — executed candidate evidence

Python 3.14.8; `uv sync --locked`; librsvg rsvg-convert version 2.63.3.
The complete suite returned **394 passed, no skips**, with
**97.66% combined coverage**:
98.02% statements and
96.53% branches. Coverage remains evidence
of exercised code, not semantic completeness.

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `uv run pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing` | PASS; coverage floor 90% |
| `uv run ruff check src tests scripts` | PASS |
| `uv run ruff format --check src tests scripts` | PASS |
| `uv run mypy src/golden_line` | PASS, complete source package |
| `uv run python scripts/check_registry.py` | PASS, every invariant |
| `uv run python scripts/build_figures.py` | PASS, complete figure inventory |
| `uv run python scripts/check_artifacts.py` | PASS, source and byte replay |
| `uv run python scripts/gen_formalism_ledger.py --check` | PASS |

The final tagged tree is rerun with `python -m golden_line.release_evidence`;
the receipt stores exact commit, every argv/output/exit status, runtime, lock,
converter and artifact hashes. An isolated no-sibling checkout is also validated.
The local collector always records external rendering as `not_run`; a separate
render receipt supplies that evidence.

The pushed implementation `2d5b1ba` also passed all six standalone CI jobs,
Python 3.10 through 3.15, in
[run 39677842447](https://github.com/docxology/golden_line/actions/runs/39677842447).
Final-release CI and exact-commit receipts accompany the published assets.

Lock SHA-256: `37160ea6423c65aec67ba0225c8d0b356d875326a41cbdee32b41d326bb0a78f`.
Registry SHA-256: `3e0a7e38ececb156336d57ed7cc60b6bf08a3d8f2edfc678270c307820df57e3`.
Converter executable SHA-256: `ca052b03ea80ce980eed448332312581962e30f078c626e380391d471e7c0ee4`.

## Rendering and visual evidence

Engine revision `4670c48cc490636455f2eac09ba4396baed9ffd7` in an isolated
detached worktree, using a managed `working/golden_line` leaf link. The shared
engine checkout was not changed. Executed commands:

```bash
uv run --no-sync python scripts/pipeline/stage_03_render.py --project working/golden_line
uv run --no-sync python scripts/pipeline/stage_04_validate.py --project working/golden_line
uv run --no-sync python -m infrastructure.validation.cli pdf projects/working/golden_line/output/pdf/golden_line_combined.pdf
```

Stage 03, Stage 04 (including rendered provenance), and the PDF CLI pass in the
isolated source checkout. The PDF contains 41 pages; page overview inspection
plus detailed cover, envelope and pipeline checks found the inherited envelope
overflow and verified its correction. HTML inspection found every figure loaded,
no broken local anchors, and no page-level horizontal overflow. Byte integrity,
source consistency, visual quality and substantive truth remain separate claims.

Earlier failed and terminated attempts are preserved, never relabeled as passes.
An archive-only engine lacked cached stage-source provenance; a direct-child
project link lacked lifecycle provenance. Canonical-checkout runs also stalled
in Git-ignore pipe I/O. A fresh isolated checkout with the required project
basename passed all checks and produced the rendered provenance receipt.
Neither engine policy nor validator was weakened. Initial fresh local validation
reported its pre-existing optional rendered-log check as not run; after rendering,
the final suite executes that check too.

| Rendered artifact | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `output/pdf/golden_line_combined.pdf` | `cf9fa97d9c5af821b5732e5332d65a1941c9d9ea5a1a9c7ca7399d5d75c8d5cf` |
| `output/web/index.html` | `7519f399a331940e8040f9c2a4d551574e78ef4517c007cf8a1877e04f534547` |
| `output/epub/golden_line_combined.epub` | `856dfc8660619b534a7004afe614917b29bcb8b0c3a9922116f72d7993f48b26` |

## Audit and release boundary

A fresh independent read-only audit assessed every G1–G11 item and requested
four corrections. All were reproduced and resolved in `2d5b1ba`: missing CFF
reference authors, the method's unqualified input guarantee, insufficient
failure-guard regression proof, and the envelope table's overbroad edit claim.
The corrected schema/prose tests initially returned three failures and one
passing control. The strengthened clean-clone collector test passes intact;
removing the exit-status guard on a disposable copy makes it fail at the
success assertion. No evaluator behavior changed for these corrections.
The original audit remains a request-changes receipt, accompanied by these
responses and subsequent passing evidence rather than relabeled approval.

Create the GitHub Release object only after a fresh repository-hooks API query
conclusively shows no Zenodo webhook. A prior query returned an empty hook list.
Otherwise omit the object and report why. Push main and the annotated tag only
through the GitVault lease, then verify both peeled commit IDs on origin.

## Daniel's follow-up and cross-repository findings

Reserve and mint the new Zenodo version DOI using the reserve-first procedure.
The retained verified DOI, `10.5281/zenodo.22833506`, identifies the preceding
Zenodo edition; this release does not claim a newly minted DOI.

Consumers should distinguish strict instrument validation from correspondence,
restore presentation order through the envelope, and retain intake/evidence
sidecars separately. External history anchoring belongs to a separate Witness
Register contract. No sibling source was edited or certified by this release.

record.title: White Line: A Typed Ledger for the Edge of the Claim
record.description:
A typed ledger for absence: epistemic gaps, ethical restraint, and contemplative negative space. It records what is missing, withheld, or unresolved under a total caution order, decays stale namings past their review horizons, and refuses to infer why anything is absent. Withholding is recorded as a boundary, never mined as missing evidence.

Subtitle: Keeping missing evidence, ethical boundaries, and open questions from becoming unsupported claims

Code is MIT licensed; prose and figures are CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE in the repository.

release.body:
# Line Set 0.5.0 (2026-10-22)

This minor release implements the 2026-10-20 deep review received 2026-10-21,
body SHA-256 `e10eef1eb425411b3e79c1773304aa96c22eeaa428ab43236baf7e8d6ee3e52f`.
It preserves the additional-topics synthesis released in 0.4.0. The implementation
and rendered-input gate runs below use `ab95b6183d0c43101591e8e615597249a97ae6f3`. Tagged-commit repetitions
and the independent pre-tag audit are retained in the Release evidence bundle;
the final receipts identify their exact commit rather than treating this packet
as a self-attestation. Software versions agree; the separately labelled archived
DOI remains associated with 0.2.0.

## Review dispositions and commits

| Review item | Disposition and commits |
| --- | --- |
| P0-1 admission | Done, `2070944`: shared minimal admission before import, malformed/duplicate identities refused, valid custom small declarations retained. Global opus checks remain separate. |
| P0-2 published aliases | Done, `2070944`: root enum `__members__`, class-identity deduplication, alias collision controls and separate census fields. |
| P1-3 binding/provenance | Done, `2070944`, `8d1c6a3`: optional versioned descriptor, fail-closed invalid declarations including present `None`, explicitly marked convention fallback, source/module identity and pinned revision checks. No sibling descriptor is invented. |
| P1-4 failure containment | Done, `2070944`, `8d1c6a3`: phase/type/detail diagnostics, retained real-finder partial discovery, process-control propagation and original real-import exception types. Imports are in-process, without a sandbox or hanging-import guarantee. |
| P1-5 uncertainty | Done, `2070944`, `433b983`, `8d1c6a3`: discovery attempt/completion/candidate outcomes, unread carriers, exact exemption coverage and meanings survive serialization independently of status. Strict boolean flags, retained yielded names and consistent failure/completion evidence are admitted at replay and pinned-source boundaries. |
| P1-6 full-table probes | Adapted, `2070944`, `8d1c6a3`: standard-library generated carrier combinations and an independent predicate replace an added property-testing dependency. Every exemption receives complete-table controls; valid prefix declarations are respected and derived spare carriers are unused. This is finite regression evidence, not a universal proof. |
| P1-7 canonical/replay | Done, `2070944`, `433b983`, `b55d128`, `8d1c6a3`, `0c600b7`: schema/version admission, exact record hash, replay recomputation, candidate coverage, nested field/container and digest-shape admission, metadata/revision validation, strict flags, type-preserving canonical comparison, golden fixtures and recomputed self-disjointness. |
| P2-8 docs/manuscript/figures | Done, `2070944`, `f766cfb`, `4f1c17d`, `acce336`, `2dcd454`, `003d4d5`, `d8a6292`, `433b983`, `b55d128`, `8d1c6a3`, `0c600b7`, `ab95b61`: executable extension fixture, historical record preservation, narrow status/formalism/front-matter prose, complete derived census ledger, isolated imports, legible plates, wrapped display transcript, complete-volume metadata/source custody, accurate partial-reading descriptions, replayed collision markers, retained-date recipe, archived DOI title and matrix descriptions. |

Every item is done or adapted; none is silently declined. The
[detailed disposition](../review-20261020.md) records executed red/green batches,
the four independent audit findings and their failing-before/passing-after
regressions, and the closest compliant architectural choices. The earlier
reading remains [verbatim historical evidence](evidence/reading-record-20260901-v1.json).
The first pre-tag audit blocked candidate `58172cb` on discovery-state admission
and two partial-reading descriptions. Executed red controls reproduced both;
`433b983` resolves them. That blocked audit and its raw regression evidence remain
in the evidence bundle. A fresh conclusive audit is required for the revised
immutable release revision; the earlier review is not approval of this release.
The second pre-tag audit blocked `4185a2d` on numeric substitutes for collision
flags. Executed controls reproduced both flag coercion and the same equality gap
in derived integer counts; `b55d128` requires boolean collision flags and
compares normalized JSON with scalar types intact. Valid exempted and unexempted
replays retain their figure markers.
The third pre-tag audit blocked `5567ffd` on six further findings. Executed
controls reproduced digest-shape admission, an explicitly invalid descriptor,
lost real-finder partial names, a reused spare carrier, the undated integration
recipe and the archived DOI title. `8d1c6a3` resolves them. Further negative
controls reproduced untyped nested provenance, diagnostics and derivation, and
malformed containers escaping the pinned gate. `0c600b7` applies the
owned reading models' declared field types before semantic checks and returns
a failed gate result for malformed records. This checks shape, not provenance
truth or explanatory prose. The [archived identity receipt](evidence/archived-identity-v0.2.0.json)
binds the corrected historical title to the retained published Zenodo response.
All three blocked reports and their executed response controls remain in the
evidence bundle; none is approval of the final immutable revision.
The fourth pre-tag audit approved `85ed6dd` with two minor findings. Executed
controls reproduced stale exemption-matrix descriptions and a missing native
bibliography path in the retained capture. `ab95b61` aligns the source
descriptions and manuscript caption with the matrix. The operator capture now
retains the bibliography at `output/pdf/omnibus_references.bib`, preserving the
native manifest path and exact source bytes alongside the manuscript copy.
The prior approval is historical; the changed candidate receives a fresh audit.
The wrapper adds no sibling evaluator call, sibling source edit, aggregate score,
ranking or inference from vocabulary separation to conceptual separation.

## Gates and current reading

Suite run dates are 2026-10-22 UTC and 2026-10-22 Pacific, using GitVault-bound Python,
environments, caches and temporary files. Both interpreter prefixes were verified
on the external volume. The configured coverage floor remains 90%.

| Command | Implementation-tree result |
| --- | --- |
| `uv run --no-sync pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing`, siblings absent | 638 passed, 16 existing conditional skips, 96.94% coverage. |
| Same command, pinned siblings present | 654 passed, 0 skips, 97.41% coverage. |
| `uv run --no-sync ruff check src tests scripts` | Pass. |
| `uv run --no-sync ruff format --check src tests scripts` | Pass. |
| `uv run --no-sync mypy src/line_set` | Pass. |
| `uv run --no-sync python scripts/check_registry.py` | Pass. |
| `uv run --no-sync python scripts/check_set.py --require-pinned --as-of 2026-10-21` | Pass, including live self-disjointness and complete pinned-source metadata. |
| `uv run --no-sync python scripts/record_reading.py --as-of 2026-10-21 --check` | Pass; current measurement agrees with the retained producer record. |
| `uv run --no-sync python scripts/build_figures.py` | Pass; own SVG, PNG and JSON outputs retained with checksums. |
| Publication metadata, documentation links, no-mocking, empty-scan, native figure bounds/point floor and planted-bad controls | Pass within both complete suites; no `--noconftest` in these lanes. |
| `git diff --check` | Pass. |
| Engine `stage_03_render.py --project working/line_set --skip-manuscript-hydration` | Pass for standalone manuscript and complete volume; PDF, HTML and EPUB generated. |
| Engine `stage_04_validate.py --project working/line_set` | Pass for standalone manuscript and generated volume projection, including native artifact manifest and rendered provenance. |

The absent lane's skips are existing live-corpus/installed-line conditions;
synthetic absence, incomplete volume and fail-closed cases still execute. The
native Pandoc formalism-reset test uses the pinned engine's actual Lua filter
and its negative control. No threshold was reduced, skip added, or red gate
masked. Earlier broad runs before the corpus path override was corrected are
excluded from final isolated-source evidence.

The current record reports 34 enum classes,
148 declared member names, 148
canonical members, 127 line-and-name pairs and
115 distinct spellings. These values are read from
`docs/manuscript/reading_record.json`, not independently asserted measurements.
Declaration digest: `de4bd085666ef66ff73aaa934cc94946530df33ad8d35d69669d514e9dcf6140`.
Exact reading digest: `d6c2743319f69caed551f5a6fcde4bf99ac851e6f1a17262f044fe1f6afc0bfe`.
Every resolved binding in this corpus retains its convention-heuristic marker;
an optional explicit binding mechanism is supported without claiming siblings
have adopted it. The record's logical date is 2026-10-21; live checks ran at the
UTC times in their command receipts.

## Sibling release custody and bounded wait

| Source | State read | Exact revision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `black_line` | `v0.5.0` | `79056aacf0f86b4287322dd5dced9d301882cb03` |
| `blue_line` | `v0.2.0` | `15ef8043833fd790e0d52a8fa47289905e4d867f` |
| `golden_line` | `v0.5.0` | `23095f7f9759a3027e5ceb8380310d54c87cd977` |
| `green_line` | `v0.2.0` | `e05007f9858bb55194b0d867aed7bed7d51777e2` |
| `red_line` | `origin/main (reported 0.3.0; directed fallback)` | `375e8ae9b7a111bcdb66f0ba33872c078083983c` |
| `silver_line` | `v0.2.0` | `3ff05b23a6a59c0f68b7a11e4cd70696f321fe0d` |
| `violet_line` | `v0.2.0` | `4bb20dbdc1c2df6cd505faee0b9729979d3892bd` |
| `white_line` | `v0.8.0` | `869aaab63c37aa118f469497cb513cf29697acda` |
| `witness_register` | `v0.2.0` | `fb3739e9724f8c237cebf32b09f3629024ac2774` |

All final reads use separate read-only Git clones at these exact states,
verified against source archive bytes. Witness Register is a release dependency
beside the namespace set, not an additional line or volume paper.

Own work became ready at `2026-10-21T20:43:26Z`. The original bound was
`2026-10-22T04:43:26.000Z`; Daniel authorized one final extension to
`2026-10-22T05:43:26.000Z`. Witness Register's released tag was first observed at
`2026-10-22T04:53:49.559288Z`, inside that window,
and its annotated tag/main ancestry was independently checked. No sibling was
still pending when the reading was sealed. Red Line did not release this round:
the dispatcher explicitly ended its wait after its authorized engine retry
timed out and directed the origin/main fallback shown above. It was not treated
as a released tag. The sibling wait ended before its final deadline.

[Machine source custody](evidence/sibling-sources-v0.5.0.json) records archive
hashes, source-file checks, clean tracked states, policies and every gathered
figure hash. Blue/Black/Golden assets and Silver's tracked figures supplied
released bundles. White/Green/Violet's own documented figure builders ran from
their pinned tags in scratch Git clones; generated bytes matched their published
artifact hashes. Red's own builder ran twice from its directed fallback revision
and produced identical bytes, without a released external figure-hash claim.
No sibling working tree supplies final reading, figure, corpus or render evidence.

## Native rendering and artifact boundary

The untouched engine is `4670c48cc490636455f2eac09ba4396baed9ffd7` in a detached
Git-indexed worktree. Actual project and supplier clones have their own Git
boundaries. Engine runs use process-scoped `core.fsmonitor=false` and no

release.body:
# Line Set 0.4.0 (2026-10-21)

This packet records the 0.4.0 release tree's gate results. Publication requires
the independent read-only audit and non-forcing remote verification described
below. A rendered receipt establishes input/output binding, not scientific
validity or publication-quality layout.

This minor release implements the additional-topics synthesis received
2026-10-21. It admits no ninth colour and reports no comparison-study results.
The body SHA-256 is
`acac51e8de78d35d2988fd927e90a74e797fbffcb9c2521eaa273322c88f59c0`.

## Synthesis disposition

| Item | Disposition and implementation commits |
| --- | --- |
| Human admission dossier and contrastive library | Done in `76c069a`; matched receipt contrast corrected in `bde63a6`. [Dossier](../admission/dossier.md) and [hypothetical cases](../admission/cases.json). Human review and native outputs remain unperformed. |
| Optional versioned evidence/replay profile | Done in `76c069a`: [convention](../evidence/README.md) and illustrative record. Adapted to a documented convention with native exporters and replay delegated to instrument owners; the wrapper never executes their evaluators. |
| Admission criteria and rejected proposals | Done in `76c069a`: [criteria](../admission/dossier.md) and [dispositions](../admission/README.md). Repair remains a candidate and allocation remains deferred. No registry entry, colour or dependency is added. |
| Bounded comparison study | Designed and scaffolded in `76c069a`: [protocol](../admission/protocol.md), separate repair representation, independent human review, no composite score, explicit do-not-add outcome. Not executed. |
| Sibling-native additions and inherited findings | Adapted to [owner requirements](../admission/sibling-requirements.md) in `76c069a` and `2977d93`. Affected-party coverage, temporal consent, explicit release, return obligations, contradiction preservation and companion-review correctness findings require owner receipts. No sibling was modified. |
| Historical reading and extension examples | Done in `76c069a`, `bde63a6`, `5e0a704`, `3ff9b33` and `c8ec2f1`: historical examples labelled, fixture description corrected, producer metadata preserved, empty measurement sets refused, all measured fields and canonical UTF-8 bytes checked. Native CLI controls reject CRLF and lone CR. |

Claim limits accompany these additions in `docs/claim_boundaries.md`. The
declaration values, digest and dated reading remain unchanged. Registry edits in
`bde63a6` are formatting only. The implementation remains standard-library-only;
no mocking framework or empirical comparison data is introduced.

## Final gate evidence

Runs on 2026-10-21, with both interpreter prefixes verified on GitVault. The
configured coverage floor remains unchanged. Existing conditional skips are
reported; none was introduced to bypass a gate.

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `uv run pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing`, siblings absent | 438 passed, 17 conditional skips, 97.02% coverage against the configured 90% floor. |
| Same command, pinned siblings present | 444 passed, 11 conditional skips, 97.02% coverage. |
| `uv run ruff check src tests scripts` | Pass. |
| `uv run ruff format --check src tests scripts` | Pass; 56 files already formatted. |
| `uv run --with mypy mypy src` | Pass; 24 source files checked. |
| `uv run python scripts/check_registry.py` | Pass. |
| `uv run python scripts/check_set.py`, pinned siblings | Pass; complete lexical reading and live self-disjointness. |
| `uv run python scripts/record_reading.py --as-of 2026-09-01 --check`, pinned siblings | Pass; retained producer 0.1.0 and checker 0.4.0 reported separately. |
| `uv run python scripts/build_figures.py` and isolated-output build | Pass; 8 SVG, 8 PNG and 2 JSON artifacts. Root and render-clone figures agree byte for byte. |
| Publication metadata, documentation links, no-mocking, empty-scan and planted-bad controls | Pass within both full suites. |
| `git diff --check` | Pass. |
| Renderer `scripts/pipeline/stage_03_render.py --project working/line_set --skip-manuscript-hydration` | Pass; PDF, HTML and EPUB generated from committed 0.4.0 source. |
| Renderer `scripts/pipeline/stage_04_validate.py --project working/line_set` | Exit 0; all native checks pass, including artifact manifest, followed by a rendered provenance receipt binding 51 source, 10 configuration and 36 output files. |

The validation report uses the renderer commit's deterministic timestamp;
the command was actually run on the date above. Its evidence-registry notices
about existing worked-example numbers remain in the raw log; the engine's
native evidence-registry check reports PASS. No stderr, threshold or result was
suppressed. The earlier 0.3.0 receipts remain in [their historical packet](v0.3.0.md)
and are not substituted for these checks.

Live checks use only pinned archive snapshots: Red `375e8ae`, Black `a40aa78`,
Golden `3a6f4b3`, White `88072dc`, Silver `c66ccb4`, Blue `fc7bde7`, Green
`f7baf9b`, Violet `f4b7183`. No sibling working tree is read. The deep-review
thread owns any later refresh of the reading and sibling-derived figures.

## Rendering and environment

Renderer source is untouched template commit
`4670c48cc490636455f2eac09ba4396baed9ffd7`, in a detached worktree with a
managed `projects/working/line_set` leaf link to an isolated committed clone.
External interpreters, environments, caches and temporary files remain on
GitVault. Process-scoped `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1`, `GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=core.fsmonitor`,
`GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false` is used; no global or repository config is changed.

The original retry was bounded at 30 minutes and remained blocked in pipe
writes after approximately 14 minutes. It was stopped only after the clean
clone passed validation and rendered provenance. A manual `git check-ignore
-v -z --stdin` with `GIT_TRACE=1` completed immediately; native samples showed
the stalled Python and Git processes both waiting in writes. This does not
establish a universal cause. Fresh-clone checks then exposed and corrected two
setup errors: an alias outside the managed lifecycle and an engine archive
without a Git source index. No engine code or check was changed or disabled.

Inherited clipping in the order, pipeline, exemption and vocabulary figures
remains visible and belongs to the deep-review owner's figure work. Passing
render validation establishes generation and input/output binding, not
scientific validity or publication-quality layout.

| Artifact | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `output/pdf/line_set_combined.pdf` | `cf7b077f40f0bef04e747f4db07889d7ec77a08a932e9265cb833a422c875c41` |
| `output/web/index.html` | `623bf634214a978333e9839ee3dd4f203633da17ab8273d6141d438b2800a65a` |
| `output/epub/line_set_combined.epub` | `a90b17ac1088965f6449bb98786d4193473727c23338ad6380e0cdd6cb8eaa1d` |

The PDF has 27 pages and is 4,217,049 bytes. The final cover was inspected; it
states that no new DOI exists. The corrected commit was rerendered and its
extracted text agrees byte for byte with the inspected 0.4.0 predecessor.
Earlier complete-page and HTML inspections are
bounded by the figure-layout limitation above. These artifacts are retained
with the release's local evidence, rather than committed as generated binaries.

## Independent review and remote publication

Earlier audits found the archive DOI association, required formatting,
matched-pair contrast and newline-normalization defects; `bde63a6` and `5e0a704`
resolve them with regression controls. The third audit confirmed those fixes
and the complete green receipts at `b4d7caa`, but withheld approval for a P3:
the extension guide incorrectly said its hypothetical fixture derived a fresh
identifier and colour. The guide now accurately describes its fixed fixture
and derived working position. The parent also reproduced acceptance of
producer-only records as an empty-measurement comparison; `3ff9b33` now
refuses either empty measurement set, with a failing-before/passing-after
control. `c8ec2f1` corrects the fixture wording. A fresh review of these
corrections is required before tagging.
The first audit's initial copied run
followed an editable installation and regenerated shared ignored figures. No
tracked files changed, and those figures were rebuilt from pinned snapshots and
verified. Its corrected run and the second strictly read-only audit did not
constitute approval of the then-blocked release.

A fresh, strictly read-only audit of the complete 0.4.0 release diff and captured
receipts is a pre-tag gate. It must perform no imports, tests, generators or
installations, and any confirmed finding blocks the tag until resolved. Its
receipt is retained alongside the release evidence. The annotated `v0.4.0` tag
identifies the reviewed release commit; main and tag are pushed through the
GitVault lease without force and verified with `git ls-remote origin`.

A GitHub Release object is permitted only after a conclusive empty repository
hook inspection, so that publication cannot trigger a Zenodo deposit outside
the reserve-first procedure. The resulting remote SHA and Release disposition
are reported in the release handoff.

## Publication follow-ups

The verified DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22833507` remains explicitly associated with
archived version 0.2.0. No DOI is assigned to 0.4.0. Daniel reserves and mints the
new DOI under the reserve-first procedure, then rerenders and deposits its exact
artifacts. The sibling owner requirements and the unexecuted comparison remain
follow-ups; none is represented as an empirical finding.

The latest code-gate receipts are
`line-set-synthesis-040-empty-fixed-absent.log`,
`line-set-synthesis-040-empty-fixed-present.log` and
`line-set-synthesis-040-empty-fixed-gates.log`. Render and validation receipts
are `line-set-synthesis-040-reviewed-render.log` and
`line-set-synthesis-040-reviewed-validate.log` in the GitVault task evidence. The traced
manual Git receipt and native process samples are also retained. The owner
must preserve these records with the exact artifacts for a future deposition.

# Line Set 0.5.0 (2026-10-22)

This minor release implements the 2026-10-20 deep review received 2026-10-21,
body SHA-256 `e10eef1eb425411b3e79c1773304aa96c22eeaa428ab43236baf7e8d6ee3e52f`.

the final receipts identify their exact commit rather than treating this packet
as a self-attestation. Software versions agree; the separately labelled archived
DOI remains associated with 0.2.0.

## Review dispositions and commits

Strict boolean flags, retained yielded names and consistent failure/completion evidence are admitted at replay and pinned-source boundaries. |

Every exemption receives complete-table controls; valid prefix declarations are respected and derived spare carriers are unused. This is finite regression evidence, not a universal proof. |
| P1-7 canonical/replay | Done, `2070944`, `433b983`, `b55d128`, `8d1c6a3`, `0c600b7`: schema/version admission, exact record hash, replay recomputation, candidate coverage, nested field/container and digest-shape admission, metadata/revision validation, strict flags, type-preserving canonical comparison, golden fixtures and recomputed self-disjointness. |
| P2-8 docs/manuscript/figures | Done, `2070944`, `f766cfb`, `4f1c17d`, `acce336`, `2dcd454`, `003d4d5`, `d8a6292`, `433b983`, `b55d128`, `8d1c6a3`, `0c600b7`, `ab95b61`: executable extension fixture, historical record preservation, narrow status/formalism/front-matter prose, complete derived census ledger, isolated imports, legible plates, wrapped display transcript, complete-volume metadata/source custody, accurate partial-reading descriptions, replayed collision markers, retained-date recipe, archived DOI title and matrix descriptions. |

Every item is done or adapted; none is silently declined. The
[detailed disposition](../review-20261020.md) records executed red/green batches,
the four independent audit findings and their failing-before/passing-after
regressions, and the closest compliant architectural choices. The earlier
reading remains [verbatim historical evidence](evidence/reading-record-20260901-v1.json).
The first pre-tag audit blocked candidate `58172cb` on discovery-state admission
and two partial-reading descriptions. Executed red controls reproduced both;
`433b983` resolves them. That blocked audit and its raw regression evidence remain
in the evidence bundle. A fresh conclusive audit is required for the revised
immutable release revision; the earlier review is not approval of this release.
The second pre-tag audit blocked `4185a2d` on numeric substitutes for collision
flags. Executed controls reproduced both flag coercion and the same equality gap
in derived integer counts; `b55d128` requires boolean collision flags and
compares normalized JSON with scalar types intact. Valid exempted and unexempted
replays retain their figure markers.
The third pre-tag audit blocked `5567ffd` on six further findings. Executed
controls reproduced digest-shape admission, an explicitly invalid descriptor,

release.body:
# Line Set 0.4.0 (2026-10-21)

This packet records the 0.4.0 release tree's gate results. Publication requires
the independent read-only audit and non-forcing remote verification described
below. A rendered receipt establishes input/output binding, not scientific
validity or publication-quality layout.

This minor release implements the additional-topics synthesis received
2026-10-21. It admits no ninth colour and reports no comparison-study results.
The body SHA-256 is
`acac51e8de78d35d2988fd927e90a74e797fbffcb9c2521eaa273322c88f59c0`.

## Synthesis disposition

| Item | Disposition and implementation commits |
| --- | --- |
| Human admission dossier and contrastive library | Done in `76c069a`; matched receipt contrast corrected in `bde63a6`. [Dossier](../admission/dossier.md) and [hypothetical cases](../admission/cases.json). Human review and native outputs remain unperformed. |
| Optional versioned evidence/replay profile | Done in `76c069a`: [convention](../evidence/README.md) and illustrative record. Adapted to a documented convention with native exporters and replay delegated to instrument owners; the wrapper never executes their evaluators. |
| Admission criteria and rejected proposals | Done in `76c069a`: [criteria](../admission/dossier.md) and [dispositions](../admission/README.md). Repair remains a candidate and allocation remains deferred. No registry entry, colour or dependency is added. |
| Bounded comparison study | Designed and scaffolded in `76c069a`: [protocol](../admission/protocol.md), separate repair representation, independent human review, no composite score, explicit do-not-add outcome. Not executed. |
| Sibling-native additions and inherited findings | Adapted to [owner requirements](../admission/sibling-requirements.md) in `76c069a` and `2977d93`. Affected-party coverage, temporal consent, explicit release, return obligations, contradiction preservation and companion-review correctness findings require owner receipts. No sibling was modified. |
| Historical reading and extension examples | Done in `76c069a`, `bde63a6`, `5e0a704`, `3ff9b33` and `c8ec2f1`: historical examples labelled, fixture description corrected, producer metadata preserved, empty measurement sets refused, all measured fields and canonical UTF-8 bytes checked. Native CLI controls reject CRLF and lone CR. |

Claim limits accompany these additions in `docs/claim_boundaries.md`. The
declaration values, digest and dated reading remain unchanged. Registry edits in
`bde63a6` are formatting only. The implementation remains standard-library-only;
no mocking framework or empirical comparison data is introduced.

## Final gate evidence

Runs on 2026-10-21, with both interpreter prefixes verified on GitVault. The
configured coverage floor remains unchanged. Existing conditional skips are
reported; none was introduced to bypass a gate.

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `uv run pytest tests/ --cov=src --cov-branch --cov-report=term-missing`, siblings absent | 438 passed, 17 conditional skips, 97.02% coverage against the configured 90% floor. |
| Same command, pinned siblings present | 444 passed, 11 conditional skips, 97.02% coverage. |
| `uv run ruff check src tests scripts` | Pass. |
| `uv run ruff format --check src tests scripts` | Pass; 56 files already formatted. |
| `uv run --with mypy mypy src` | Pass; 24 source files checked. |
| `uv run python scripts/check_registry.py` | Pass. |
| `uv run python scripts/check_set.py`, pinned siblings | Pass; complete lexical reading and live self-disjointness. |
| `uv run python scripts/record_reading.py --as-of 2026-09-01 --check`, pinned siblings | Pass; retained producer 0.1.0 and checker 0.4.0 reported separately. |
| `uv run python scripts/build_figures.py` and isolated-output build | Pass; 8 SVG, 8 PNG and 2 JSON artifacts. Root and render-clone figures agree byte for byte. |
| Publication metadata, documentation links, no-mocking, empty-scan and planted-bad controls | Pass within both full suites. |
| `git diff --check` | Pass. |
| Renderer `scripts/pipeline/stage_03_render.py --project working/line_set --skip-manuscript-hydration` | Pass; PDF, HTML and EPUB generated from committed 0.4.0 source. |
| Renderer `scripts/pipeline/stage_04_validate.py --project working/line_set` | Exit 0; all native checks pass, including artifact manifest, followed by a rendered provenance receipt binding 51 source, 10 configuration and 36 output files. |

The validation report uses the renderer commit's deterministic timestamp;
the command was actually run on the date above. Its evidence-registry notices
about existing worked-example numbers remain in the raw log; the engine's
native evidence-registry check reports PASS. No stderr, threshold or result was
suppressed. The earlier 0.3.0 receipts remain in [their historical packet](v0.3.0.md)
and are not substituted for these checks.

Live checks use only pinned archive snapshots: Red `375e8ae`, Black `a40aa78`,
Golden `3a6f4b3`, White `88072dc`, Silver `c66ccb4`, Blue `fc7bde7`, Green
`f7baf9b`, Violet `f4b7183`. No sibling working tree is read. The deep-review
thread owns any later refresh of the reading and sibling-derived figures.

## Rendering and environment

Renderer source is untouched template commit
`4670c48cc490636455f2eac09ba4396baed9ffd7`, in a detached worktree with a
managed `projects/working/line_set` leaf link to an isolated committed clone.
External interpreters, environments, caches and temporary files remain on
GitVault. Process-scoped `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1`, `GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=core.fsmonitor`,
`GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=false` is used; no global or repository config is changed.

The original retry was bounded at 30 minutes and remained blocked in pipe
writes after approximately 14 minutes. It was stopped only after the clean
clone passed validation and rendered provenance. A manual `git check-ignore
-v -z --stdin` with `GIT_TRACE=1` completed immediately; native samples showed
the stalled Python and Git processes both waiting in writes. This does not
establish a universal cause. Fresh-clone checks then exposed and corrected two
setup errors: an alias outside the managed lifecycle and an engine archive
without a Git source index. No engine code or check was changed or disabled.

Inherited clipping in the order, pipeline, exemption and vocabulary figures
remains visible and belongs to the deep-review owner's figure work. Passing
render validation establishes generation and input/output binding, not
scientific validity or publication-quality layout.

| Artifact | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `output/pdf/line_set_combined.pdf` | `cf7b077f40f0bef04e747f4db07889d7ec77a08a932e9265cb833a422c875c41` |
| `output/web/index.html` | `623bf634214a978333e9839ee3dd4f203633da17ab8273d6141d438b2800a65a` |
| `output/epub/line_set_combined.epub` | `a90b17ac1088965f6449bb98786d4193473727c23338ad6380e0cdd6cb8eaa1d` |

The PDF has 27 pages and is 4,217,049 bytes. The final cover was inspected; it
states that no new DOI exists. The corrected commit was rerendered and its
extracted text agrees byte for byte with the inspected 0.4.0 predecessor.
Earlier complete-page and HTML inspections are
bounded by the figure-layout limitation above. These artifacts are retained
with the release's local evidence, rather than committed as generated binaries.

## Independent review and remote publication

Earlier audits found the archive DOI association, required formatting,
matched-pair contrast and newline-normalization defects; `bde63a6` and `5e0a704`
resolve them with regression controls. The third audit confirmed those fixes
and the complete green receipts at `b4d7caa`, but withheld approval for a P3:
the extension guide incorrectly said its hypothetical fixture derived a fresh
identifier and colour. The guide now accurately describes its fixed fixture
and derived working position. The parent also reproduced acceptance of
producer-only records as an empty-measurement comparison; `3ff9b33` now
refuses either empty measurement set, with a failing-before/passing-after
control. `c8ec2f1` corrects the fixture wording. A fresh review of these
corrections is required before tagging.
The first audit's initial copied run
followed an editable installation and regenerated shared ignored figures. No
tracked files changed, and those figures were rebuilt from pinned snapshots and
verified. Its corrected run and the second strictly read-only audit did not
constitute approval of the then-blocked release.

A fresh, strictly read-only audit of the complete 0.4.0 release diff and captured
receipts is a pre-tag gate. It must perform no imports, tests, generators or
installations, and any confirmed finding blocks the tag until resolved. Its
receipt is retained alongside the release evidence. The annotated `v0.4.0` tag
identifies the reviewed release commit; main and tag are pushed through the
GitVault lease without force and verified with `git ls-remote origin`.

A GitHub Release object is permitted only after a conclusive empty repository
hook inspection, so that publication cannot trigger a Zenodo deposit outside
the reserve-first procedure. The resulting remote SHA and Release disposition
are reported in the release handoff.

## Publication follow-ups

The verified DOI `10.5281/zenodo.22833507` remains explicitly associated with
archived version 0.2.0. No DOI is assigned to 0.4.0. Daniel reserves and mints the
new DOI under the reserve-first procedure, then rerenders and deposits its exact
artifacts. The sibling owner requirements and the unexecuted comparison remain
follow-ups; none is represented as an empirical finding.

The latest code-gate receipts are
`line-set-synthesis-040-empty-fixed-absent.log`,
`line-set-synthesis-040-empty-fixed-present.log` and
`line-set-synthesis-040-empty-fixed-gates.log`. Render and validation receipts
are `line-set-synthesis-040-reviewed-render.log` and
`line-set-synthesis-040-reviewed-validate.log` in the GitVault task evidence. The traced
manual Git receipt and native process samples are also retained. The owner
must preserve these records with the exact artifacts for a future deposition.

# Release packet — White Line 0.8.0 (2026-10-21)

from the repository-version citation.

tag conventions remain historical.

| --- | --- |

| 3 envelope boundaries | Separate narrow matching, schema/contract validation and trusted whole-envelope integrity; custom registry version policy and collection-shape checks |

| 5 untrusted dates/producers | Unsupported objects remain accepted-undated without equality calls; finite well-behaved producers required and exceptions propagate without partial reports |

| 6B defect battery | Adapted to targeted detection plus reported collateral failures; no exclusivity claim |

The branch and annotated tag are pushed only through the repository lease,

is created only after a fresh hooks query confirms no Zenodo webhook; an
inconclusive query or any Zenodo hook blocks that object.

Daniel reserves and mints the next Zenodo version DOI using the reserve-first

deposition, not a newly minted 0.8.0 deposition.

repository was edited, committed, branched or pushed.

record.title: White Line: A Typed Ledger for the Edge of the Claim
record.description:
A typed ledger for absence: epistemic gaps, ethical restraint, and contemplative negative space. It records what is missing, withheld, or unresolved under a total caution order, decays stale namings past their review horizons, and refuses to infer why anything is absent. Withholding is recorded as a boundary, never mined as missing evidence.

Subtitle: Keeping missing evidence, ethical boundaries, and open questions from becoming unsupported claims

Code is MIT licensed; prose and figures are CC BY 4.0. See LICENSE in the repository.

release.body:
# Active Assembly Theory and Practice 0.1.0

Archival DOI: [10.5281/zenodo.23484108](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23484108).
Source commit: `2a7356b4ecf66dc8382f4978564c41fd637bd343`.

A bounded computational research demonstrator and 90-page technical monograph,
packaged with source, scientific figures, actual GNN runtime capsules and
SHA-256 manifests. Project-owned software and documentation use the MIT license;
third-party dependencies retain their own licenses.

The canonical finite models execute through the configured upstream GNN parser
and real pymdp Agent. Real Julia/RxInfer consumes the shared categorical
tensors. Independent smoothing parity, malformed-input controls and prospective
action-before-acquisition checks are retained. Fitted statistical diagnostics

record.title: Active Assembly Theory and Practice
record.description:
Assembly traces can support explicit probabilistic inference without being treated as recovered program meaning. Active Assembly Theory and Practice makes that distinction executable: transparent x86-64 fixtures are decoded with Capstone, traced under bounded Unicorn emulation, and mapped to typed observations that distinguish missing, unseen, and unsupported evidence. Two Generalized Notation Notation (GNN) specifications define passive-phase and prospective sensor models whose tensors drive real pymdp execution. A native categorical Julia/RxInfer companion consumes the passive model's same parameters (Friedman 2026; Heins et al. 2022; Bagaev et al. 2023). The sensor Agent selects an action before fixture evidence is acquired. Independent finite calculations check beliefs and policy scores; native smoothing uses the same parameters and first-observation convention. Every inference comparator and fitted diagnostic also consumes an upstream-parsed numeric GNN specification, with source-bound runtime instances and rendered model graphs.

A corpus of 10 authored fixtures supports complete-fixture exclusion diagnostics. At the fixed informative likelihood, the memoryless decoder outperforms the temporal filter; temporal advantages appear under synthetic observation ambiguity. Designed category ambiguity remains a visible failure case. The separate Gaussian and categorical Bethe free-energy diagnostics are not compared numerically with policy expected free energy.

The quotient benchmark contains 64 transformation-family identifiers and 4096 rows, with 16 families held out from model fitting. The co-primary portfolio includes an interpretable classifier, a temporal probabilistic model, a fixed one-layer tanh recurrent classifier, and surface baselines; the temporal endpoint reaches balanced accuracy 0.775 and macro-F1 0.772 on this frozen bounded benchmark. Held-out identifiers share authored template lineages with the fitting data. Family-resampling intervals and conditional randomization diagnostics therefore describe this finite inventory; the retrospective protocol correction withholds superiority claims. A complementary pinned static-only corpus supplies 5 licensed source projects and 100 source-contract rows, including 40 lexical witnesses, 40 contract-directed near misses, and 20 identity controls. The corpus establishes provenance and coverage; it does not execute arbitrary external binaries or support application-effectiveness claims.

Selected normalized machine-state relations are checked by Python, native execution, and a bounded Lean fragment. Exact finite sensing certificates and source-bound reader artifacts make assumptions and failures inspectable. Independent physical replication remains unearned. The contribution is a reproducible substrate for testing assembly-to-inference mechanisms, with explicit limits on semantics, statistical generalization, and external validity.

- Catch the existing exit-code documentation contract early in frozen release preflight and documentation CI. Refresh python-dateutil to 3.0.0 within existing constraints.

## Rendering and environment

clone passed validation and rendered provenance. A manual `git check-ignore
-v -z --stdin` with `GIT_TRACE=1` completed immediately; native samples showed
the stalled Python and Git processes both waiting in writes. This does not
establish a universal cause. Fresh-clone checks then exposed and corrected two
setup errors: an alias outside the managed lifecycle and an engine archive

with the release's local evidence, rather than committed as generated binaries.

## Independent review and remote publication

Earlier audits found the archive DOI association, required formatting,
matched-pair contrast and newline-normalization defects; `bde63a6` and `5e0a704`
resolve them with regression controls. The third audit confirmed those fixes
and the complete green receipts at `b4d7caa`, but withheld approval for a P3:
the extension guide incorrectly said its hypothetical fixture derived a fresh
identifier and colour. The guide now accurately describes its fixed fixture
and derived working position. The parent also reproduced acceptance of
producer-only records as an empty-measurement comparison; `3ff9b33` now
refuses either empty measurement set, with a failing-before/passing-after
control. `c8ec2f1` corrects the fixture wording. A fresh review of these
corrections is required before tagging.
The first audit's initial copied run
followed an editable installation and regenerated shared ignored figures. No
tracked files changed, and those figures were rebuilt from pinned snapshots and
verified. Its corrected run and the second strictly read-only audit did not
constitute approval of the then-blocked release.

A fresh, strictly read-only audit of the complete 0.4.0 release diff and captured

A GitHub Release object is permitted only after a conclusive empty repository
hook inspection, so that publication cannot trigger a Zenodo deposit outside
the reserve-first procedure. The resulting remote SHA and Release disposition
are reported in the release handoff.

archived version 0.2.0. No DOI is assigned to 0.4.0. Daniel reserves and mints the

artifacts. The sibling owner requirements and the unexecuted comparison remain
follow-ups; none is represented as an empirical finding.

The latest code-gate receipts are
`line-set-synthesis-040-empty-fixed-absent.log`,
`line-set-synthesis-040-empty-fixed-present.log` and
`line-set-synthesis-040-empty-fixed-gates.log`. Render and validation receipts
are `line-set-synthesis-040-reviewed-render.log` and
`line-set-synthesis-040-reviewed-validate.log` in the GitVault task evidence. The traced
manual Git receipt and native process samples are also retained. The owner
must preserve these records with the exact artifacts for a future deposition.

# Release packet — Witness Register v0.2.0

Prepared 2026-10-21 America/Los_Angeles; completed runs continued on
2026-10-22 UTC. This minor release changes authority, return lifecycle and
validation behavior while retaining co-registration without aggregation.
No native status is interpreted and no permission or utility service is added.

## Source custody and release procedure

Review base: `09358d44fe7cde0d3e1814f702a444a05310ea69`.
Review body SHA-256: `759261260a54355247292a15a43da5d698d21e926e022acc8e34603cebf23506`.
Measured implementation: `2bddacd4511d6a747494d7df22c2654e79b6d3c3`. The release snapshot adds
this packet, its generated evidence JSON and a directory-guidance correction
naming the existing operator-skill tests (independent audit R5-01). A fresh clone of that final
commit must repeat all local gates, render and complete stage04, with the same
explicit build epoch `1792642961`, and compare delivered bytes and consumed
source/configuration fingerprints against this measurement before tagging.
Execution logs retain actual observation times; deterministic artifact dates
use the implementation commit epoch. A failed repeat or audit blocks the tag.

## Review disposition and commits

`244047d` implements WR-01 through WR-10 in packet priority order, with failing
regressions before each reproduced defect. `c332708` supplies independent-audit
repairs, additional red/green controls, operator synchronization and the final
eight-line cohort. `2bddacd` repairs the final audit's
relation-target reopening defect and presentation findings. Full acceptance details are in
[the implementation ledger](../review-20261020.md).

| Item | Result | Commits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| WR-01 | Separate classification and exact-target resolution authority; all relation types and support inflation | `244047d`, `c332708` |
| WR-02 | Immutable open/completed pairs, orphan/duplicate refusal, linked partial remainder; permitted pair-model adaptation retained | `244047d`, `c332708` |
| WR-03 | Shared typed structural validation at projection and chain boundaries; context-specific checks remain explicit | `244047d`, `c332708` |
| WR-04 | Append-only lifecycle events, reopening through relation/contract targets, descendant propagation, conflict visibility and categorical block precedence | `244047d`, `c332708`, `2bddacd` |
| WR-05 | Exact target/use rescope; unrelated obligations stay open | `244047d`, `c332708` |
| WR-06 | Detached strict bounded JSON, exact digests, wrapper budgets, old/new canonical vectors | `244047d`, `c332708` |
| WR-07 | String register identity, canonical unchanged history, real dates and explicit backdating boundary | `244047d`, `c332708` |
| WR-08 | Correct manuscript scope to global constraints and authored exact-use events; wording invariance already passed | `244047d`, `c332708` |
| WR-09 | Narrow binding separated from semantic replay; segment/genesis/anchor coverage with denominators | `244047d`, `c332708` |
| WR-10 | Deterministic combined missing/malformed diagnostics | `244047d`, `c332708` |

No item was silently dropped. Existing rationale/trigger and wording-invariance
controls did not reproduce defects and remain unchanged in meaning. A state-only
projection cannot validate an omitted chain or unrelated supplied projection;
`project_chain` and semantic replay cover those contexts. Missing authored
relations remain a declared limitation; automatic constraint inference would
violate the contract. The return proposition is limited to authored RETURN_DUE
links. Historical authority strings and seals remain historical; new relation,
return, state and projection shapes use schema 2.0 with explicit migration and
no automatic clearance. Envelope schema remains 1.0.

## Local gates on the implementation tree

Measured Python 3.12.13, external interpreter and environment prefixes verified.
**403 passed**, no skips; combined statement/branch coverage
**96.38%**, floor 90%.
The branch-only numerator is 448/466,
or **96.14%**; the combined percentage above
includes statements and branches.
Every declared local gate passed; generated ledger and cohort match tracked
bytes. Two figure builds produced identical bytes for all
9 artifacts. Additional Python 3.11.17 focused
interchange/lifecycle/audit/battery checks passed; this is not a full-version
support-matrix claim. Installed-wheel checks ran outside the source checkout:
real intake, chain, scoped resolution trajectory, battery and every defeat.

## Sibling snapshots and bounded wait

read under the owned sibling clone/export directory. No live sibling tree was
used. Violet contributes only its already-published worked envelope.

A corrupted PDF copy is rejected and the original digest remains unchanged.

All PDF pages were rendered and visually inspected, with full-size checks of
cover, authority, return propositions and battery. HTML was inspected in an
isolated Chrome session: all four images load, no local anchor targets are
missing, and layout is legible. The collaborative preview loaded but twice

## Failed additional checks and independent audit boundary

Earlier native and Linux external-engine infrastructure smoke attempts timed
out. A later additional smoke run completed with 226 passed, three failed and
one deselected by the engine's existing selection: three evidence-registry
fixture expectations failed when non-repository temp paths inherited the
GitVault meta-repository ignore rules. The engine sanitizes its Git subprocess
environment, so the proposed ceiling variable does not repair it and was

An additional published-index provenance helper rejected the standalone clone
